blocks.text: Religious communities in Metro Manila mark the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law with a Mass at the Immaculate Conception Cathedral of Cubao in Quezon City on Monday, Sept. 21. PHOTO COURTESY OF THE FRANCISCAN POST NOVITIATE FORMATION – OFM PHILIPPINES MANILA, Philippines — The Conference of Major Superiors in the Philippines (CMSP) reminded Filipinos on Monday, Sept. 21, that remembrance should not end in words but in a sustained action to protect democracy and the common good.
